pod_placement.description: Node a pod runs on, in a scenario.
pod_placement.sql: SELECT node_name FROM k8s_object WHERE kind = 'Pod' AND name = $pod AND scenario_id = $scenario::INTEGER

pods_on_node.description: Pods in namespace otel-demo on a node, in a scenario.
pods_on_node.sql: SELECT name FROM k8s_object WHERE kind = 'Pod' AND namespace = 'otel-demo' AND node_name = $node AND scenario_id = $scenario::INTEGER

service_callees.description: Services a service calls directly (from traces), in a scenario.
service_callees.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.service FROM span c JOIN span p ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id AND c.trace_id = p.trace_id AND c.scenario_id = p.scenario_id WHERE p.service <> c.service AND c.scenario_id = $scenario::INTEGER AND p.service = $service

service_error_spans.description: Error spans of a service (timestamp, operation, duration ms), in a scenario.
service_error_spans.sql: SELECT ts, operation, duration_ms FROM span WHERE service = $service AND status = 'Error' AND scenario_id = $scenario::INTEGER
